focus: security -- holdout hygiene and arena containment

findingDetails.title: The dotenv skip and the containment claim cover regular files only, so a symlinked entry is copied as a link that can point outside the arena
findingDetails.scopeProof: Walk, dotenv guard and copy call are all in the scoped builder; header comments at lines 12-34 are the claims tested.
affectedSurfaceHints: live turn file and shell tools
findingDetails.claim: holdsDotenv does not follow a symlinked directory and cp -R copies the link, so an npm/pnpm linked package inside node_modules arrives pointing outside the arena.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether copyPlan excludes linked entries, whether cp is called with a dereference flag, and whether any later step re-checks the arena tree; none does.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The header's containment claim could be read as covering only git state, in which case the symlink is out of its scope; the header also claims no dotenv enters at any depth, which the linked tree breaks.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if link handling is stated as an operator responsibility in the owning workflow.

findingDetails.title: A dotenv file tracked in the commit under test is cloned into the arena, because the dotenv guard runs only on the copied build trees
findingDetails.scopeProof: Clone, copy plan and guard are all in the scoped builder; the claim is the header dotenv rule at lines 31-34.
findingDetails.claim: The dotenv skip is applied only to the ignored trees copyPlan returns; a tracked dotenv file is materialised by the clone and never inspected.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the builder for any other dotenv check; checked whether the runner re-validates the arena tree for secrets; it does not. Checked this repository's tracked files for a dotenv file and found only .env.example files.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The guard may target only build output by design, leaving git state to the operator; the header sentence it contradicts is broader than that.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if the builder is documented as trusting every tracked file of the commit.

findingDetails.title: The single copy call uses the macOS clonefile flag with no platform check
findingDetails.scopeProof: The copy call is in the scoped builder; the CI lane running the behaviour tests on ubuntu is cited as platform evidence.
findingDetails.claim: runCp always spawns cp -Rc, a macOS clonefile flag, so an arena with any ignored build tree cannot be built where cp rejects the flag.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked for a platform branch or fallback around runCp; none. Checked the builder tests: both build a source with no ignored tree, so the copy path is not exercised on the ubuntu lane.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The live arms may be documented as macOS-only operator work, making the flag intentional; no such statement exists in the builder or the README row that describes it. The failure mode on a non-macOS cp is inference from the flag's documented meaning.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if the README states the arena builder runs on macOS only.

traceabilityChecks.notes: Every holdout and containment guard named by the brief or the module header was matched to the line implementing it; three builder gaps recorded.
